checks.label: Grid sizing and pagination tests
checks.scope: Clamping widths, autosize bounds and safe page indices; does not execute the grid DOM.

checks.label: DataGrid interaction stories
checks.scope: Play assertions cover selected full-presentation, filter-layout, header-control and keyboard-resizing scenarios. The presentation includes additional host behavior.

checks.label: Record filter model tests
checks.scope: Reducer transitions, facet combination, time boundaries and WorkRecord matching; not a rendered FilterBar interaction run.

checks.label: FilterBar interaction stories
checks.scope: Play assertions cover query clearing, view controls, picker commits, panel visibility and focus after last-filter removal.

checks.label: PageHeader navigation story
checks.scope: Play assertions cover heading level, back precedence, callback activation, action focus order and host editing state.

checks.label: Product data contract rendering checks
checks.scope: Back-link precedence, requested heading level/id and optional slot omission. Static server rendering only; does not exercise browser interaction or certify accessibility.

checks.label: SideNav keyboard stories
checks.scope: Play assertions cover expanded groups, collapsed menu keyboard selection/dismissal, focus return and active child state.

checks.label: Product data contract rendering checks
checks.scope: Zero-total and out-of-range display normalization, current-page semantics and disabled boundaries. Static server rendering only; does not exercise browser interaction or certify accessibility.

checks.label: Product data contract rendering checks
checks.scope: Loading replacement, nonfinite delta omission, neutral zero and decrease-favorable semantics. Static server rendering only; does not exercise browser interaction or certify accessibility.

checks.label: Product data contract rendering checks
checks.scope: Loading precedence, empty labeling and normalization of negative/nonfinite samples. Static server rendering only; does not exercise browser interaction or certify accessibility.

checks.label: Product data contract rendering checks
checks.scope: Native term/value pairing and strict missing substitution preserving zero and distinguishing false. Static server rendering only; does not exercise browser interaction or certify accessibility.

checks.label: Product data contract rendering checks
checks.scope: Preset distinction, section/title associations and absence of an automatic live-alert role. Static server rendering only; does not exercise browser interaction or certify accessibility.

checks.label: Clearable controlled-input story
checks.scope: Clearable play assertion checks the cleared value, native onChange host update and returned input focus; not every input type or form-reset case.

checks.label: AutoGrowAndCounter typing story
checks.scope: Typing and rendered UTF-16 character count in one controlled fixture; not a comprehensive auto-growth or form-reset test.

checks.label: DebouncedSearch story
checks.scope: Typing and clearing update a local result-count fixture through the debounced callback; no remote request cancellation or race proof.

checks.label: KeyboardSelection story
checks.scope: Controlled option selection with ArrowDown/Enter and return of focus to the trigger; bounded story coverage, not every form/readOnly case.

checks.label: ReadOnlyAndDisabled and SelectAll stories
checks.scope: Read-only controls remain focusable and immutable, disabled controls stay unavailable, and the local aggregate fixture changes mixed/checked state by click and Space.

checks.label: ImmediateSetting story
checks.scope: A controlled local switch changes on pointer activation and Space; not evidence of persistence or comprehensive native-form behavior.

checks.label: KeyboardSelection story
checks.scope: Native radio selection moves from Monthly to Quarterly with ArrowRight after pointer selection; no tab-panel or stable form-name behavior is asserted.

checks.label: HeaderAlignmentAndClose and ResizeFocus stories
checks.scope: Overlay header/scroll behavior, close/trigger focus return, pointer-vs-keyboard focus styling and resize keys; does not cover every docked or nested-overlay lifecycle.

checks.label: ScrollableBody story
checks.scope: Body scrolling leaves header/footer fixed, the close action is available, and Escape returns focus to the trigger in one fixture.

checks.label: PasswordInput initial rendering tests
checks.scope: Default concealment, Field associations, disabled/read-only states and native prop forwarding; static rendering only.

checks.label: PasswordInput interaction stories
checks.scope: Play assertions cover typing, forwarded input focus, both change channels, reveal/conceal without submission, native FormData and read-only reveal; source linkage is not a passing result.

checks.label: NumberInput render semantics
checks.scope: Five static checks cover null/zero distinction, exact form naming, localized display/raw form separation, Field associations, locks and shared optional buttons; browser interaction is separate.

checks.label: NumberInput interaction stories
checks.scope: Keyboard and bounds, controlled empty values and callbacks, German form entry, Field/locked states and cancellation. A linked story is not a passing run.
